# Marea Enciclopedie despre insecte by Litera

Dive into the fascinating world of insects with the "Great Encyclopedia about Insects" from Litera. Discover an incredible collection featuring over 400 insects, taking you on an adventure through the diverse and amazing lives of these tiny creatures.

## Explore the Vibrant World of Insects

This comprehensive book is packed with fascinating information, stunning visuals, and expert knowledge. Whether you are a beginner or an avid entomologist, this encyclopedia offers detailed insights into the habitats, communication methods, and unique behaviors of insects.

### Stunning Photo Galleries and Detailed Facts

Inside this volume, you will find more than just text. Each page is an adventure featuring vibrant, multicolored photo galleries that allow you to see these incredible creatures up close.

*   **Vibrant Imagery:** Experience impressive images of insects, ranging from familiar species like the Monarch butterfly and the house spider to extraordinary creatures such as the Atlas moth and the bombardier beetle.
*   **Expert Selection:** Every image has been carefully selected by an expert entomologist, ensuring you receive the most precise and up-to-date information available.
*   **In-Depth Knowledge:** Gain detailed knowledge on everything from insect habitats to their complex methods of communication, making every page a unique discovery.

## Why Choose This Encyclopedia?

This book is designed to be an engaging and educational resource for anyone interested in entomology. It provides amusing facts and useful information sheets, turning the study of insects into an exciting journey. Step confidently into the marvelous world of bugs!

**Price:** $109.99

[Shop Marea Enciclopedie despre insecte on Litera](https://www.litera.ro/marea-enciclopedie-despre-insecte)

***

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: How many insects are covered in this encyclopedia?**
A: This book covers more than 400 insects, offering a broad and detailed overview of insect life.

**Q: Is the information accurate?**
A: Yes, the information is based on the selection and expertise of entomologists, providing precise and current details about insect habitats and behaviors.

**Q: Who is this book for?**
A: This encyclopedia is perfect for students, nature lovers, hobbyists, and anyone curious about the amazing world of insects.
